content.full_text: An Amedkarite Dalit history from the 1940's onwards, of 12 settlements in Bandra, a Christian-dominated western suburb of Mumbai. The author is a resident of Ambedkar Nagar in Khar/ Bandra. वांद्रेयेथील आंबेडकरी बारापाखाड्यांचा इतिहास
